label: The fixed selected conjunction actually holds and fails at some…, by Same-effect-failure-contradic…
meaning: Use the existing whole-ground modal necessitation with the two explicit selected-record guards. Contingency of positive b supplies an accessible SAME failure world v. If all members of THIS g held at v, whole necessitation would make that SAME positive b true there, contradicting its failure. Combine this joint failure with supplied actual JointTrue to obtain existing JointContingent of h.members g. No frame, coherence, autonomy, causal, concrete-bearer, R or ingredient premise is added. The effect’s actual truth remains in the retained Contingent input, although this joint-failure proof uses only its accessible-absence field; no minimality is claimed.
